why: Drops the tint reset from the pool's acquire path. One pool now serves both looks, so the sprites a refusal retired are handed straight to the next ordinary shot -- and every shot after that one, on that tank, comes out black. It is invisible until a refusal happens, which is what makes it a defect rather than a mistake anyone would notice while developing: a match that never hits the shell cap renders correctly all the way through.
killedBy: muzzle smoke (issue #536, parent #356) gives a recycled cloud the look of the event that reused it, not the one that retired it
